name: 40th Annual Boat Parade of Lights and Holiday Village
address: Downtown Panama City Marina, Panama City, FL 32402
when_note: Holiday Village 4 to 7 PM, drone show 5 PM, boat parade 5:30 to 7:30 PM
host: City of Panama City and Destination Panama City
paras: The City of Panama City lists the 40th Annual Boat Parade of Lights for Saturday, December 12, 2026, on St. Andrews Bay. Destination Panama City teams up with the city to present the parade of boats decorated with Christmas lights.

A Holiday Village at the Downtown Panama City Marina runs from 4 PM to 7 PM with holiday vendors, festive music and a visit from Santa. A drone show follows at 5 PM, and the boat parade runs from 5:30 PM to 7:30 PM. The route starts at the St. Andrews Bay Yacht Club and travels west past downtown, the Panama City Marina, West Beach Drive, the St. Andrews Marina, Historic St. Andrews and Sun Harbor Marina, ending at the Hathaway Bridge. Viewers can watch from the shoreline, the marinas or waterfront restaurants, and the public votes on the best decorated boat. The city page does not print a price.
tip: Arrive for the 4 PM Holiday Village, then claim a marina spot before the 5 PM drone show.
